name: Qatar Petroleum PS-2 and PS-3 offshore platforms - EPIC upgrade of instruments and control systems
description: Yokogawa Bulletin 00A01A55-01EN (copyright 2016): Yokogawa Middle East awarded the engineering, procurement, installation and commissioning contract for the control-system upgrade at PS-2 and PS-3 in the Maydan Mahzam and Bul Hanine fields; replacement of Honeywell DCS, GE Fanuc PLC and pneumatic controllers with a FOUNDATION Fieldbus-enabled CENTUM CS 3000 DCS; nearly 1,000 FF devices; Cutover within a 30-day shutdown. No contract value printed.
